label: KNOWLEDGE_1: Knows a x is successful object-directed KNOWLEDGE_1 in the mode tested, not the Form…
definition: Knows a x is successful object-directed knowledge in the mode tested, not the Form of Knowledge itself, not omniscience and not a definition of propositional justified belief. The agent-indexed reconstruction projects the relation of knowledge to its object in Parmenides 134a–e; its closure principle remains disputed.
note: Additive interface for issue #259. Parmenides 130e–131e and 133b–134e, Phaedo 74b–d / 100d–e and Aristotle Metaphysics I.9 motivate these contrasts; none defines the modern typed interface. Sourcing a replacement would require a passage fixing this exact scope.
